_comment: Hierarchical MILP AllGather on mini_2gpu_2nic with switch copy. 4 hosts x 2 GPUs, each GPU owns its own 100Gbps NIC (2 uplinks per host), 2 leaves / 2 spines. The only mini variant that can run hierarchically: mini_1gpu_1nic has no host tier to fold, and mini_2gpu_1nic's shared NIC hangs off the PCIe root complex, which cannot be a cell (see its .topo). milp_chunking='holder': one MILP chunk = one holder GPU's chunks for one destination-cell set (b = num_chunks for allgather). Keeps multipath across a host's uplinks. switch_copy [true, false]: the network switches of the coarse level copy -- a fan-out is one Send, charged once on its uplink, and ncclize emits it as ONE multicast send threadblock (tb send="r1,r2") with one mscclflowid, plus a switch-JSON (format 2) entry listing every out port; the cell NVSwitches do not copy (multicast there needs NVLS). Pass --no-multicast to ncclize for the pre-multicast output (one unicast send per branch). SLOWEST_LINK keeps every coarse link at >= 1 chunk/epoch (occupancy 1: no multi-epoch legs). objective_type 6 (LEXICOGRAPHIC) puts makespan first; PAPER (3) ties on it. Outputs: Schedules/<prefix>_flat.json (+ _coarse/_identities/_intra side outputs). See teccl/hierarchy/milp_design.md and teccl/ncclize/multicast_output_design.md.
